oil.when: 2002 (GM Oil Life System, trip/reset button and Driver Information Center)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to RUN but do not start the engine.
Press the trip/reset button repeatedly until OIL shows in the Driver Information Center.
Press and hold the trip/reset button for about five seconds until the number changes to 100.
Turn the key off. If the change engine oil message comes back on, repeat the steps.
